alignment.failurePolicy: reject width mismatch, out-of-region/height, third-party overlap, source hash mismatch or failed native clearance; no flattening or corridor substitution

portClasses.RECTANGULAR_FLAT: Existing dry flat full-floor and rectangular empty ingress checks, unchanged baseline semantics
portClasses.ORIGINAL_STAIR_TRANSITION: Boundary plane retains original metadata feet; internal band uses source-bound support profile and native collision verification, not an all-air rectangular prism

s8_01_north.profileAuthority: Actual source states captured; sub-block shape is analytic expectation pending native getCollisionShape verification

s8_07.internalNavigation: NOT_CERTIFIED: boundary strips do not establish whole-room north-to-south traversal
s8_07.southAttachmentToS8_01: REJECT width5 vs width3 even after Y translation; requires genuine width5 peer or separately approved outside tapered adapter, not silent width truncation

ownershipAndReservations.wholeRoom: Every original explicit block/air/entity payload remains source-owned; no edit inside template to flatten stairs or create a substitute passage
ownershipAndReservations.internalBand: Owned subset of its parent room: overlay annotation, not a second foreign box. Do not reject expected room-vs-own-band overlap
ownershipAndReservations.externalShell: Use frozen corridorBounds at translated world feet, including floor/ceiling/side walls; no cap at doorway
ownershipAndReservations.allOthers: Before writes, test translated full rooms + external shells + any external transition allowance against existing world protected/occupied volumes, other rooms and every prior external reservation in all3axes
ownershipAndReservations.internalEndpoint: Exterior shell ends outside the true face. It must not overwrite any source stair/support/headroom cell
ownershipAndReservations.persistentRecord: Store source hash, original metadata, translated origin, q, band/shape verification policy hash, owned boxes and verifier results; fail closed after restart if evidence differs

requiredNativePosterior: Load exact hash-bound original NBT at translated origin with all four rotations; preserve original BlockState properties and payloads. No promotion from Python air checks or manual geometry alone.

Read every protected-band state and compare to exact rotated source; re-read after neighbour-shape stabilization. Obtain actual BlockState.getCollisionShape with world, position and player CollisionContext. Do not equate non-air with solid, or stairs with full cubes.

Resolve support surfaces of both half-steps with native VoxelShape, including boundary neighbour cells. Verify continuous support and maximum riser <= actual player's stepHeight (target vanilla0.6), not arbitrary full-block jumps.

Verify each stair tread and riser transition with continuous swept AABB, standing player width0.6 and height1.8, not only point centers. Include near-neighbour collision shapes and the entire 3-block declared overhead clearance above the supported path. For full-width claims check full declared opening-width overhead; do not claim3-wide from centerline alone.

Verify exterior approach -> original boundary -> original stairs -> inner landing and reverse, all three lanes, all four rotations, then a full required-room-port return route. S8-07 north2 to south4 interior route requires its own native sweep; exported boundary columns are not sufficient.

Repeat source/readback and clearance after tick updates; no global gamerule suppression. Run native player-motion or equivalent collision solver including step-up, descent, ceiling, lane edges and head sweep, not teleport-only samples.

Before COMMITTED fail on body/head collision, unsupported tread, width mismatch, blocked landing, protected overlap, out-of-world bounds, altered original blocks, fluid/unknown dynamic behavior or native verifier unavailable; preserve persistent failure evidence and use runtime's actual recovery policy.
